assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and dizziness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The ICD-10 code for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is I48.0
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The ICD-10 code Z86.73 corresponds to personal history of transient ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered
The CPT code for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is 93229
The purpose of the mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
The service addresses the documented indication for identifying clinically significant arrhythmias underlying the patient's recurrent syncope and dizziness
